Region of origin code (conditional reveal), Consignment conforms to regulatory requirements (with per-option hints), Will consignment change vehicles

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom container class on the conditional-reveal wrapper that holds the 'Enter the region code' text input (shown when region-of-origin = Yes).
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke class layered on top of the standard govuk-radios__conditional reveal. Cosmetic; not a Design System class.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: govuk-radios__conditional (already present) — the box styling can be dropped; the standard conditional reveal covers the behaviour.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom divider element inside the region-code conditional reveal.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke IPAFFS class, no Design System equivalent used here; purely visual separation.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: None needed — standard conditional reveal does not require a divider.

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: conform-uk-regulations (used as a CSS class, not just an id)
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: The field id 'conform-uk-regulations' also appears as a class token on an element in the conform question markup.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Non-govuk class name (an id reused as a class hook). Minor; likely a JS/styling hook. Does not change component behaviour.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: No custom class needed — standard Radios covers this.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom modifier on the GOV.UK back link to position it alongside breadcrumb/dashboard navigation.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use the standard govuk-back-link in the normal content position, or a standard breadcrumbs component where hierarchical navigation is needed.

fields.name: origin-country
fields.label: Country of origin
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for CHED-P in the downstream model: Commodities.countryOfOrigin is @NotNull for NotificationHighRiskFieldValidation and NotificationCvedpEuFieldValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/Commodities.java:168-180), with message key resolved at ValidationMessages.properties:86. On this edit page the frontend Joi schema rejects the empty placeholder with COUNTRY_REQUIRED (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:36-39). This is legacy mandatoriness 'as the old system had it'; the rebuild may revisit draft-save timing.

fields.name: region-code-option
fields.label: Does the consignment require a region of origin code?
fields.hint: This is only required if the consignment needs a health certificate that shows a region of origin code.
fields.requiredEvidence: Optional in the legacy page validator: region-code-option is Joi.boolean().optional() (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:45). The legacy template defaults No when no saved region exists (service/src/views/importer/consignmentCountries.html:94-101), so it is not a user-mandatory selection.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 17 (radio values Yes=true, No=false; No checked by default)

fields.name: region-code
fields.label: Enter the region code
fields.requiredEvidence: Optional even when the Yes reveal is chosen in the authorised legacy validator: region-code is Joi.string().allow('').alphanum().min(1).max(3), so the empty string is explicitly accepted and there is no conditional required rule tied to region-code-option (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:31-45). The transformer unsets regionOfOrigin when the submitted region code is null or empty (service/src/transformers/view_to_notification/importer/consignment_countries.js:41-50).
fields.conditionalOn: shown only when 'Does the consignment require a region of origin code?' = Yes (govuk-radios--conditional reveal)
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 17 (input#region-code inside govuk-radios__conditional--hidden; verbatim hint 'Enter up to 5 characters.'; DOM maxLength is 3; govuk-input--width-3). The contradictory hint and DOM constraint are both preserved.

fields.name: consigned-country
fields.label: Country from where consigned
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for CHED-P in the downstream model: Commodities.consignedCountry is @NotNull for NotificationCedOrCvedpFieldValidation and NotificationCvedpEuFieldValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/Commodities.java:189-201), with message key resolved at ValidationMessages.properties:87. The page validator constrains a supplied value to 6 characters but does not itself use .required() (service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:51-56); the disabled placeholder and saved value make the model constraint the authoritative mandatoriness evidence. Legacy policy may revisit incomplete draft saves.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 17; trace 0a6f82fcd63c4cd83fcab91687b522f3f865a74e action 17 (placeholder option is disabled)

fields.name: conform-uk-regulations
fields.label: Does this consignment conform to regulatory requirements?
fields.hint: This refers to points (a) and (d) of Assimilated Regulation 2017/625.
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for CVEDP in the legacy page validator: conform-uk-regulations is Joi.boolean().required(), with missing and non-boolean failures mapped to CONFORMS_TO_UK_REGULATION (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:51-65). It maps to partOne.purpose.conformsToEU, which has no @NotNull annotation in Purpose.java:41-45, so this is frontend journey mandatoriness 'as the old system had it' and may be revisited for draft-save policy.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 17 (radio values Yes=true, No=false; Yes checked by default). Per-option hints captured in openQuestions/structure. Hint contains a link 'points (a) and (d) of Assimilated Regulation 2017/625.' -> https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2017/625/article/1; QA group/Yes locator page-objects/notification/OriginOfImportPage.ts:6 and selection in every CHED-P workflow variant workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:282, workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:676 and workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:862

fields.name: transport-details-required
fields.label: Will the consignment change vehicles or means of transport after the Border Control Post (BCP)?
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for CVEDP in the legacy page validator: transport-details-required is Joi.boolean().required(), with missing and non-boolean failures mapped to TRANSPORTER_DETAILS (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:51-60). fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 17 (radio values Yes=true, No=false; No checked by default, test checks Yes); QA group/Yes locator page-objects/notification/OriginOfImportPage.ts:13 and selection in every CHED-P workflow variant workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:283, workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:677 and workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:863

fields.name: health-certificate-required
fields.label: Does your consignment require a health certificate?
fields.requiredEvidence: Not a CHED-P control in the authorised legacy page: consignmentCountries.html contains no health-certificate-required field, and its CVEDP-only controls are conform-uk-regulations plus transport-details-required (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/consignmentCountries.html:122-175). The QA-only inferred field therefore has no applicable legacy required rule and remains non-required.
fields.conditionalOn: Unknown page/journey variant. The shared OriginOfImportPage exposes this control, but it was absent from both CHED-P traces and no CHED-P workflow or test invokes it.
fields.evidence: QA-only group and No-option locator page-objects/notification/OriginOfImportPage.ts:10. The three CHED-P workflow variants drive only regulatory conformity and change-after-BCP before continuing at workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:282, workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:676 and workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:862.

openQuestions: RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: the two persisted countries are mandatory in CHED-P model validation (Commodities.java:168-180,189-201; ValidationMessages.properties:86-87). The page validator supplies 'Select the country of origin of the animal or product' for an empty origin select and 6-character maximum messages for both country codes (validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:31-65).

Per-option radio HINTS on the conform question are rendered as govuk-radios__hint: Yes -> 'The consignment conforms to the regulatory requirements and the goods are for the internal market, transit, transshipment or movement for ship supply.'; No -> 'The consignment does not conform to regulatory requirements. Transits, transshipments, or movement for ship supply may not need to meet the regulatory requirements, if not intended for the internal market.' (both confirmed at trace 94d29... action 17).

The country dropdowns carry 254 options (incl. placeholder). This is reference data — the new app should source it from a reference-data/country service, not hardcode. Note the ordering quirk: the four UK constituent countries (England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, Wales) appear mid-list between 'United Arab Emirates' and 'United States Minor Outlying Islands' rather than alphabetically, and their order differs between the two selects (origin: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, Wales; consigned: England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland).

LEGACY-VS-RENDERED COPY/CONSTRAINT DISCREPANCY: the trace-confirmed and legacy-template hint says 'Enter up to 5 characters.' (consignmentCountries.html:80-82), but the CHED-P template input maxlength and server validator both enforce 3 characters (template:88-90; routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:62-69; validation/.../consignment_countries.js:40-43), with error 'Region code must be 3 characters or fewer'. Keep the confirmed hint, but the rebuild must choose and align one limit. Legacy also confirms region code is not required even when Yes is selected because empty is explicitly allowed.

The <title> is 'Add a reference number for this consignment' — IPAFFS derives the page title from the last field rather than the H1 'Origin of the import'. Recorded verbatim; the new app should title by the page heading.

RESOLVED FROM LEGACY AS NOT A CHED-P PAGE CONTROL: the authorised CHED-P template and validator contain no health-certificate-required field (consignmentCountries.html:122-175; validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_countries.js:31-94). The QA-only inferred locator is stale or belongs to another historical variant; do not add this control to the CHED-P rebuild without separate evidence.

The QA page object corroborates only the regulatory-conformity and change-after-BCP groups plus Continue (page-objects/notification/OriginOfImportPage.ts:6-18). It has no counterparts for the two country selects, region-code controls or optional local reference; those remain trace-only confirmed requirements.

Legacy policy point: countryOfOrigin and consignedCountry are @NotNull in CHED-P model validation, while conform-uk-regulations and transport-details-required are required only by frontend Joi. The latter two persisted booleans have no model @NotNull. Preserve the observed legacy journey enforcement but decide whether incomplete draft saves should remain blocked.
